latestArticle.title: NASA Checks Roman Guidance System, Takes First Coronagraph Observation
latestArticle.summary: NASA’s Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope’s fine-guidance system, which allows the observatory to lock very steadily onto its targets during observations, passed a spate of tests from Sept. 15 to 21. Then on Sept. 22, the mission’s Coronagraph Instrument opened its eyes to cosmic light for the very first time. The team assigned a small […]

milestones.title: Launch
milestones.description: Lifted off on a SpaceX Falcon Heavy from Launch Complex 39A.

milestones.title: Mid-course correction #1
milestones.description: Approximately three-minute burn to refine Roman’s trajectory toward L2.

milestones.title: Deployable aperture cover
milestones.description: The visor-like deployable aperture cover deployed successfully.

milestones.title: Coronagraph Instrument power-on
milestones.description: Roman’s technology-demonstration Coronagraph Instrument was successfully activated.

milestones.title: Mid-course correction #2
milestones.description: NASA rescheduled the second correction for later September following the precise first burn.

milestones.title: Wide Field Instrument power-on
milestones.description: NASA confirmed activation and initial instrument checks on 15 September 2026.

milestones.title: Ground stations validated
milestones.description: All supporting ground stations demonstrated reception of Roman data, including tests at its maximum downlink rate.

milestones.title: Fine-guidance tests passed
milestones.description: Initial fine-guidance stability tests passed. Further tuning and spectral guiding validation remain ahead.

milestones.title: First Coronagraph observations
milestones.description: Initial focused-star and subsequent pointing observations succeeded. These are commissioning tests, not completion of observatory alignment or the first science-image release.

milestones.title: Alignment & focus
milestones.description: Optical alignment, focusing, calibration, and observatory checkout continue.

milestones.title: L2 orbit insertion
milestones.description: Roman enters its operational orbit around the Sun–Earth L2 region.

milestones.title: First science images
milestones.description: Release of the first science images after alignment and calibration. NASA already published an out-of-focus engineering test image on 15 September; that does not complete this milestone.

milestones.title: Science operations
milestones.description: The mission begins its science operations after commissioning.
